heroSection.headline: Omada Gateways: Secure and Reliable Business Networking
heroSection.subtext: Discover a complete lineup of professional wired, wireless, and integrated gateways designed for centralized management and robust security.

gatewayTypes.name: Wired Router
gatewayTypes.description: High-performance, secure, and reliable wired gateways for business networks of all sizes. Offering advanced VPN features and load balancing.

products.name: Omada 10G Multi-Gigabit VPN Router
products.description: An enterprise-grade VPN router with 10G ports, designed for high-speed, reliable, and secure business networks. Features a quad-core 2.2 GHz CPU, centralized cloud management, and dual redundant power supplies.

products.name: Omada Multi-Gigabit VPN Router

specs.wanPorts: Up to 6 WAN ports (2x 2.5G RJ45, 4x Gigabit RJ45/SFP)

products.description: A professional, secure, and reliable gateway with up to six WAN ports and two 2.5G ports. It's designed for centralized management and offers high-security VPN and load balancing features.

products.name: Omada Gigabit VPN Router

specs.wanPorts: Up to 4 WAN ports (1x SFP, 3x RJ45)

products.description: A professional, secure, and reliable gateway with up to 4 WAN ports, perfect for small and medium-sized businesses. It supports a wealth of VPN features and is seamlessly integrated into the Omada SDN platform.

products.name: Omada Gigabit VPN Router

specs.wanPorts: Up to 4 WAN ports (1x Gigabit WAN, 2x Gigabit WAN/LAN, 1x USB)

products.description: A compact and reliable gigabit VPN router suitable for small offices and remote work. It provides multiple WAN ports for load balancing and supports various VPN protocols for secure connectivity.

gatewayTypes.name: WiFi Router
gatewayTypes.description: All-in-one gateways that combine a high-speed Wi-Fi 6 router with powerful wired routing and VPN capabilities.

products.name: Omada AX3000 Gigabit WiFi 6 VPN Gateway

specs.wanPorts: Up to 5 WAN ports (1x SFP, 4x RJ45)
specs.wifi: AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 (2402 Mbps on 5 GHz, 574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz)

products.description: An enterprise-grade dual-band wireless router that combines AX3000 WiFi 6 with multi-gigabit wired performance. Supports mesh technology, seamless roaming, and centralized management.

gatewayTypes.name: 5G/4G WiFi Router
gatewayTypes.description: Stay connected anywhere with high-speed cellular gateways. Perfect for temporary locations, mobile deployments, or as a reliable backup internet source.

products.name: Omada 4G+ Cat6 AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 Outdoor/Indoor Gateway
products.description: A versatile indoor/outdoor gateway with 4G+ and Wi-Fi 6 for flexible, high-speed connectivity. Its IP55 weatherproof enclosure ensures durability in harsh outdoor conditions.

products.name: Omada 4G+ Cat6 AX3000 Gigabit VPN Gateway with PoE+
products.description: Combines 4G+ Cat6 cellular access, AX3000 Wi-Fi 6, and PoE+ ports in a single device, ideal for environments requiring both wireless connectivity and power for connected devices.

products.name: Omada 4G+ Cat6 AX3000 Gigabit VPN Gateway
products.description: Offers high-speed cellular internet access with AX3000 Wi-Fi 6 and extensive VPN capabilities, all managed centrally through the Omada SDN platform.

gatewayTypes.name: Integrated Router
gatewayTypes.description: Simplify your network with a 3-in-1 device that combines a router, PoE+ switch, and the Omada controller in one compact, fanless unit.

products.name: Omada 3-in-1 Gigabit VPN Router
products.description: A highly-integrated 3-in-1 business gateway that includes a router, 8-port PoE+ switch, and an embedded Omada Controller. Manage your entire network from a single, cost-effective device.
features: Router, PoE+ Switch & Omada Controller in one

faqs.question: How do I add an Omada Gateway into the network?
faqs.answer: You can add an Omada Gateway via the Omada SDN Controller. The process involves connecting the gateway to your network, discovering it in the controller interface, and then adopting it to apply centralized configuration.

faqs.question: What should I do if the Omada Gateway fails to be adopted?
faqs.answer: Check for IP address conflicts between the gateway and other devices on your network. Ensure the controller can reach the gateway and that the gateway's firmware is compatible with your controller version. You may need to manually set the controller's inform URL on the gateway.

faqs.question: How to configure Load Balancing on Omada Gateway?
faqs.answer: Load Balancing can be configured in the Omada Controller under the 'Transmission' > 'Load Balancing' section. You can enable it and set policies for how traffic is distributed across multiple WAN ports.

faqs.question: What VPN protocols do Omada routers support?
faqs.answer: Omada routers support a wide range of VPN protocols, including IPsec, L2TP, PPTP, SSL, OpenVPN, and WireGuard, allowing for secure connections for remote employees and site-to-site networks.
